title: Certify coded p19 compiler reserve at a conditional planning endpoint (no new κ)
body:
PR #4940 leaves the finite compiler constants for its declared coded p19 inventory open. This package supplies a strict arithmetic instance with 128 chronological copies and logarithm power 140, replacing the failing inherited 1024/1000 choice.

The independently reconstructed inventory retains all 19 complete native/helper profiles, 20 thin queries and both IDLE tails: 12,008 targets and 68,782 paid calls. Two separate exact rational interval implementations certify both completion/splitting tails and shifted compiler capacity. Exact integer arithmetic gives the sufficient normalized compiler rank encoding `2^4106900000000`. All 54 strict outer predicates and four functional guards pass at the planning endpoint `0.00339999`, conditional on realizing this declared inventory under the source physical and compiler contracts.

**No new admitted κ.** This does not establish a source-bound physical p19 caller or identify its coded outputs as independent Gaussian jobs. Physical code/frame mixing, odd-denominator recoding, arbitrary-input/helper returns, complete nonrecursive precision/storage/tape work and the inherited BIT/analytic/recovery premises remain explicit prerequisites. The two active physical-pair and denominator-13 claims in Discussion #4930 remain distinct work; further compiler parameter scans do not resolve them. The selected record is unchanged.

Validation: registered Python 3.12 replay; optimized direct replay; metadata/source pins; committed-byte preflight; official 17-file export and integrity check; optimized export replay with no Git on PATH and networking disabled. Controls reject omitted query charges, the inherited compiler choice, insufficient conservative tensor power, closed outer gaps and insufficient BIT headroom. The optional full source-history check is unavailable because this checkout is shallow; this is recorded separately from the passing committed-byte check.

Canonical claim: https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/4930#discussioncomment-19139629. Written derivation and scope are in `research/coded-compiler-closure/PROOF.md`; exact receipt and every remaining prerequisite are in `RESULT.json`. Open next questions and predecessor credit are in the README and task metadata.

Credit SethBurkart123's PR #4940; Dugongue/mdumitrean's PR #4929; Dillon's PR #4933; Cinna Davis's PR #4440/4470; Cao Yifan/intqwq's PR #4610; zxv's higher-moment/compiler and interval work; Jacob Alan Sussman's mixed flow; and retained native, Clifford, BIT and outer contributors. Prepared by Cinna Davis with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance. Apache-2.0; no independent human or proof-kernel acceptance claimed.
